operational_meaning: the eight-point search at B3/train_40k/seed0 doubles as the core cell source

promotion happens only after the full search selects its winner AND the winning run is validated against the complete frozen recipe constants, the complete 19-field resumable checkpoint and provenance requirements, and every per-run gate (G0, G4-G13, G14-64, G15, G18)
any validation failure stops and returns to the user; no automatic rerun exists
